description: This file is a Perl script named 'chainlint.pl'. It functions as a static analysis tool for shell script test definitions, scanning scripts for potential problems such as broken command chains, unclosed heredocs, and other coding issues within test scripts. It includes multiple classes for parsing shell scripts and test commands, with detailed tokenization and recursive descent parsing logic. The script also handles command-line options, multi-threaded execution, and output formatting.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Perl class responsible for tokenizing POSIX shell scripts, including handling of heredocs, strings, and special shell characters.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: Recursive descent parser for POSIX shell scripts, capable of parsing shell command syntax, compound commands, and script structures.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that is aware of test constructs within shell scripts, checking for common pitfalls in test commands such as missing '&&' or '|| return 1'.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions in scripts, and invokes TestParser for each test body to detect problems.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for Lexer class, initializes lexer with buffer and parser context.

methods.name: scan_token
methods.description: Tokenizes the next shell token, handling whitespace, strings, operators, comments, and heredocs.

methods.name: parse_cmd
methods.description: Parses a shell command or command sequence from the token stream.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main entry point for parsing a sequence of shell commands until a stop token is encountered.

methods.name: find_non_nl
methods.description: Utility to find the last non-newline token in a token list.

methods.name: ends_with
methods.description: Checks whether a sequence of tokens ends with specific patterns, useful for detecting missing command chain operators.

methods.name: format_problem
methods.description: Formats internal problem codes into human-readable messages.

methods.name: check_test
methods.description: Analyzes a test command for problems using TestParser and reports issues.
